It can protect the internal goods from extrusion and collision, and also realize the classification and identification of goods. The light brown appearance against the black background is simple and intuitive, highlighting its functionality and versatility as a packaging container.

Functional Features:This is an industrial-grade plastic storage bin commonly used for warehouse management, material sorting, and logistics operations. Its functional features include lightweight durability, stackability, and easy labeling for inventory tracking. It is ideal for storing components, tools, or semi-finished products in automated warehouses, production lines, and distribution centers. The front label with barcode and item codes facilitates integration with warehouse management systems (WMS), enabling efficient tracking and dispatch. Its standardized design supports stacking and compatibility with AGVs or robotic arms, enhancing operational efficiency.
Visual Features: Visually, the bin is made of high-strength purple plastic, offering high visibility in dense storage environments. Constructed from polypropylene or polyethylene, it provides excellent impact resistance and chemical durability. The surface has a matte finish for slip resistance and wear protection, with reinforced edges for added strength. Molded handles on both sides allow for easy manual handling and robotic gripping. The design balances functionality with visual management, making it a staple in modern logistics and storage systems.

Functional Features:This is a standardized cardboard shipping box designed for express delivery, warehouse dispatch, cross-border e-commerce, and supply chain logistics. Its functional features include high-capacity storage, secure sealing, and comprehensive labeling, making it suitable for packaging large items or bulk materials. The box is marked with EXTRA LARGE and ABA EXPRESS DELIVERY SERVICES, indicating its role as a standard unit in a courier system. The surface is matte with clearly printed branding, size indicators, and compliance icons. It is sealed with transparent tape for added stability and protection during transit. The overall design emphasizes readability, structural integrity, and compatibility with logistics systems, making it a common and essential form of packaging in modern delivery networks.

The bold FRAGILE marking serves as a clear visual cue to ensure careful handling and reduce the risk of damage during transit.

The box is sealed with transparent packing tape to maintain structural integrity during transport. The overall design emphasizes visibility, protection, and logistics compatibility, making it a standard packaging solution for fragile goods in modern supply chains.
